title: Cambridge IELTS 16 Test 1 Writing Task 1
directions: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.
prompt: The charts below show the changes in ownership of electrical appliances and amount of time spent doing housework in households in one country between 1920 and 2019.
scenario: The charts compare the percentage of households with a washing machine, refrigerator and vacuum cleaner, and the number of hours of housework per week per household, between 1920 and 2019.
requirements: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

visualData.title: Percentage of households with electrical appliances (1920–2019); Number of hours of housework* per week, per household (1920–2019)
visualData.units: Percentage of households; number of hours per week per household
notes: Electrical-appliance ownership values shown for 1920, 1940, 1960, 1980, 2000 and 2019.
Hours of housework per week per household: 50, 35, 20, 15, 15, 10.
